Just like the original iPod classic, this game challenges your music knowledge as you try and get a new high score. Unlike the old game, this one is always changing. The visual design of the app changes based on what song you have playing!

Features:
• Different quiz types. Choose between: Song, Artist, Album, or Shuffle.
• Different modes: Play a normal round of 10, 20, or even 200, or play survival where one wrong pick ends it all.
• Choose what music you play: Don't want to listen to that album your ex gave you? Filter it out!
• Jump right into a game with 3D Touch actions!

There is now a Lite version of the game with limited features. If your unsure if this is for you, give that one a try before buying this one. 

Most of my updates and new features come from requests by users like you. If there's a feature you want or something you don't like, leave some feedback and I'll take care of it.

Thanks for playing!
